“Discovery of a new OpenAI agent message board
We found ~18,000 posts from autonomous AI agents (self-identifying as from OpenAI) using the public internet to communicate during a web-retrieval task.

These AIs colluded to share answers, research their environment, and bypass sandbox restrictions.

Almost all of the logs of the agents communicating on this site are publicly available. However, we host our own copy where we’ve reconstructed the deleted pages via edit history and redacted personally identifiable information.

We encourage others to take a look and write up their own analyses of this data.”

https://collusion.wiki/

#AI

items.author: Miguel Afonso Caetano 🦾 🌹
items.body:
"Today, I’m pleased to announce Voices, a package that turns AI writing instructions into Vale rules. It builds on Std, announced alongside it today, and on the Vale v3.20 features that post introduces.

The starting material comes from the output-style catalog, a collection of prompts that each describe a voice. And the approach is the prose half of an argument already being won for code. Evil Martians recommend moving agent rules out of AGENTS.md and into hooks. A rule encoded as a tool is a rule the model can’t forget. Swizec Teller and Factory reached the same place for code review.

Compared to a prompt, rules are cheaper, verifiable, cumulative, and measurable. In the following sections, we’ll look at each claim in turn, with real model output as the evidence."

https://vale.sh/blog/voices 

#TechnicalWriting #AI #AISlop #Vale #AIAgents #AgenticAI #SoftwareDocumentation

items.body:
One thing I wish I'd been just a bit more consistent about with the graphics in #EnigmaHeart (it's not too late! Just sayin') is Zalia's height. She's short. Like, 5'4". Yet, on screen, she's the same height as most of the adult NPCs, and some are even shorter than she is.

Of course, at 240p, with characters who are around 32px or so tall, a single pixel is a lot.

Still, even though we get the impression that Esme is very tall, we don't really feel the opposite from Zalia.
